title: Inka period
text: Most khipus of the corpus date to the Inka period; radiocarbon dates, where tested, fall here.

title: Huanca lords record what they gave the Spaniards
text: Their khipus, read out in court, keep the shares of the valley's three parts, 4 : 2 : 3 (Chirinos 2010).

title: A summary khipu equals twelve detail khipus
text: Hatun Xauxa's summary of 1558 is the sum of the detail khipus shown in 1561 (Chirinos 2010). No such pair survives in the corpus.

title: Third Council of Lima
text: The council orders khipus to be destroyed; the court record of khipu readings ends soon after.

title: Wilhelm Gretzer arrives in Peru
text: A textile merchant from Hanover, he builds the largest collection of its time, mostly from grave robbers.

title: Macedo collection to Berlin
text: Berlin buys about 2,400 objects from José Mariano Macedo of Lima.

title: Eduard Gaffron practises medicine in Lima
text: His collection later reaches Berlin (the Huacho khipus VA 63038–63044), Detmold and other museums.

title: Max Uhle excavates at Pachacamac
text: The first systematic excavation of the sanctuary.

title: Baessler gift
text: Arthur Baessler gives Berlin about 11,690 objects.

title: Khipus 'between Ica and Pisco' reach Berlin
text: Among them AS114, whose block recurs on AS123.

title: Berlin buys Gretzer's collection
text: About 40,000 objects, most labelled Pachacamac, among them UR212, AS131, AS170 and AS175.

title: The Ica khipus AS143, AS149, AS179 enter Berlin
text: One allocation spread over three khipus of the same batch.

title: Gaffron khipus in Detmold
text: Entered with other objects from his collection.

title: Basel buys khipus dug near Huacho
text: The ship's doctor Arnold Masarey sells a cache of cords; the museum's report calls them calendar records.

title: Nordenskiöld mounts the Huacho khipus
text: Ten fragments and loose cords are sewn onto a cloth, IVc.366.03, and pieces face both ways.

title: Nordenskiöld's calendar reading
text: He publishes the calendar hypothesis but not the Basel khipus.

title: The Aschers' Databooks
text: Cord-by-cord records of more than 200 khipus, with observations such as the 7 + 7 parts of AS131 and AS170.

title: Inkawasi storehouse excavated
text: Alejandro Chu recovers 34 khipus, some under chili peppers, peanuts and black beans.

title: Urton & Chu on Inkawasi
text: Matched pairs and fixed deductions 10, 15, 47, 208.

title: Conklin khipus at Dumbarton Oaks
text: UR297 and UR298 enter the collection.

title: Huacones-Vilcahuasi
text: Eleven khipus found rolled together near a chili storeroom and a floor yupana.

title: Medrano traces the Basel khipus to Huacho
text: The museum archive names the burial ground near Huacho and the 1924 mounting.

title: This atlas
text: Corpus-wide search: every link between surviving khipus is a copy of one account.
